The nectar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the glacier until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the spiral of the next round.
